related.description: :zap: A new cd command that helps you navigate faster by learning your habits.
Command-line productivity booster, offers quick access to files and directories, inspired by autojump, z and v.
Jump quickly to directories that you have visited "frecently." A native Zsh port of z.sh with added features.
A smarter cd command. Supports all major shells.
Zsh plugin that converts ..., ...., ....., etc., into cd commands to navigate parent directories.
